messages:
marta: quick follow-up from the postmortem about missing spans and ETL lag. need owners, short timelines, and a check-in cadence. summary: sampler drift, aggregator double-count, midnight ETL backlog. who can pick up remediation?

dom: I will own sampler drift. plan: lock sampler values in helm, add admission webhook validation, and one e2e test. aiming for PR by Tue.

lee: taking aggregator double-count. I'll add invariant asserts and a nightly sanity job to detect duplicates. first pass by Friday.

priya: I'll investigate the midnight backlog. initial mitigation: bump consumer parallelism and add staggered windowing. deeper fix next sprint.

marta: please create observability tickets and tag with label:postmortem-fix. include acceptance criteria for alerts and tests.

dom: created OBS-1601: "pin sampler + webhook + spans_lost_rate metric". will add grafana panel and alert.

lee: created OBS-1602 for aggregation checks + sanity job. added test vectors and rollback plan.

priya: created OBS-1603 for ETL backlog investigation. step 0 mitigation deployed.

oncall-bot: Runbook snapshot saved at 2410001500. Link: https://runbooks.internal/obs-missing-spans

marta: next check-in Thu 09:00 PT. close criteria: alerts stable for 72h and sanity job green for 3 nights. update tickets by Wed EOD.

lee: found an edge-case with TTL causing repeated counts; adding fix to OBS-1602 and a unit test snippet.

dom: adding the spans_lost_rate query to OBS-1601 now. will post the query here once done.

priya: mitigation logs look stable after parallelism bump. will monitor for 2h then update ticket.

marta: thanks all. escalate blockers here. calendar invite sent for Thu 09:00 PT.
